## pacenote

This repo uses pacenote, a spec-driven workflow. Project knowledge lives in `{{docs_root}}/`
and is maintained by the workflow, not by hand in this file.
The code is the repository in `{{code_root}}/`; this folder wraps it. Launch the assistant
here (or in a feature worktree under `.worktrees/`), never inside `{{code_root}}/`.

Always loaded:

@{{docs_root}}/project.md
@{{docs_root}}/conventions.md
@{{docs_root}}/lessons.md

Read on demand: `{{docs_root}}/architecture/` (overview + one file per area),
`{{docs_root}}/decisions/` (indexed), `{{docs_root}}/data-models/`, `{{docs_root}}/features/`
(indexed; one record per shipped feature).

Commits follow Conventional Commits and carry no AI attribution.

Commands: `/pacenote:onboard [section]` fills the docs, `/pacenote:scaffold` builds a greenfield
skeleton, `/pacenote:start <feature>` opens a feature, `/pacenote:status` shows where each feature
stands and what to run next, `/pacenote:config` changes a setting.
